segments.text: Reaction Workup 1. Extracting, washing, and drying.
segments.zh: 反应后处理（一）：萃取、洗涤和干燥。

segments.text: As all chemists quickly learn, it is very rare for a chemical reaction
segments.zh: 所有化学工作者很快都会认识到，化学反应

segments.text: to provide only the one compound that you're looking for.
segments.zh: 只生成你想要的那一种化合物，是非常罕见的。

segments.text: Even highly selective reactions generate the desired product as a crude mixture
segments.zh: 即使是高选择性的反应，生成的目标产物也是粗混合物，

segments.text: containing byproducts and unreacted starting materials and reagents.
segments.zh: 其中含有副产物以及未反应的起始原料和试剂。

segments.text: Liquid-liquid extraction is the most common technique
segments.zh: 液-液萃取是最常用的技术，

segments.text: for separating a compound from a complex mixture.
segments.zh: 用于从复杂混合物中分离出某种化合物。

segments.text: In an extraction, you can take advantage of differing solubilities
segments.zh: 在萃取中，你可以利用溶解度的差异，

segments.text: to selectively separate the different components.
segments.zh: 有选择地分离不同的组分。

segments.text: By carefully planning out an extraction and washing sequence,
segments.zh: 通过仔细规划萃取和洗涤的顺序，

segments.text: otherwise known as a workup, the desired product can usually be
segments.zh: 也就是所谓的后处理，通常就能把目标产物

segments.text: separated from the unwanted impurities. This video will illustrate the proper
segments.zh: 与不需要的杂质分离开。本视频将演示

segments.text: technique involved in working up a reaction.
segments.zh: 反应后处理所涉及的正确操作技术。

segments.text: In an ideal world, each chemical reaction in the laboratory
segments.zh: 在理想世界里，实验室中的每个化学反应

segments.text: would provide only the desired product in its pure form.
segments.zh: 都只会生成纯净形式的目标产物。

segments.text: In reality, the product is almost always generated as part of a messy mixture of
segments.zh: 而实际上，产物几乎总是作为一个杂乱混合物的一部分生成，

segments.text: byproducts and sideproducts. In short, garbage.
segments.zh: 混合物里还有各种副产物。简而言之，就是一堆垃圾。

segments.text: Liquid-liquid extraction is a useful technique
segments.zh: 液-液萃取是一种很有用的技术，

segments.text: used to isolate the desired compound from a complex mixture.
segments.zh: 用于从复杂混合物中分离出目标化合物。

segments.text: In an extraction, the mixture is partitioned between two
segments.zh: 萃取时，混合物在分液漏斗中

segments.text: immiscible solvents in a separatory funnel,
segments.zh: 分配于两种互不相溶的溶剂之间，

segments.text: otherwise known as a SEP funnel. The key is that the two solvents are mutually
segments.zh: 分液漏斗也叫 sep funnel。关键在于这两种溶剂

segments.text: insoluble, so they form two distinct layers.
segments.zh: 彼此不相溶，所以会形成两个明显的液层。

segments.text: One of the solvents is almost always water, and the other
segments.zh: 其中一种溶剂几乎总是水，另一种

segments.text: is an organic solvent of your choice. The different components of the mixture
segments.zh: 是你选择的有机溶剂。混合物中的不同组分

segments.text: are selectively distributed in one solvent or the other,
segments.zh: 会有选择地分配到其中一种溶剂中，

segments.text: depending on their different solubilities. In this way,
segments.zh: 这取决于它们各自的溶解度。这样，

segments.text: you can take advantage of differing solubilities to selectively transport
segments.zh: 你就可以利用溶解度的差异，有选择地把

segments.text: solutes from one layer to another. In most cases, but not all,
segments.zh: 溶质从一层转移到另一层。在大多数情况下（但并非全部），

segments.text: neutral organic molecules prefer the organic phase,
segments.zh: 中性有机分子倾向于留在有机相，

segments.text: while charged molecules and inorganic salts prefer the aqueous layer.
segments.zh: 而带电分子和无机盐则倾向于留在水层。

segments.text: By carefully planning out an extraction and washing sequence,
segments.zh: 通过仔细规划萃取和洗涤的顺序，

segments.text: otherwise known as a reaction workup, the desired compound can usually be
segments.zh: 也就是所谓的反应后处理，通常就能把目标化合物

segments.text: separated from most of the unwanted impurities.
segments.zh: 与大部分不需要的杂质分离开。

segments.text: This brings up an important point. What is the difference between an extraction
segments.zh: 这就引出了一个要点：萃取和洗涤

segments.text: and a wash? These terms describe similar but fundamentally different
segments.zh: 有什么区别？这两个术语描述的是相似但本质不同的

segments.text: operations. An extraction involves pulling the desired compound out of a mixture of
segments.zh: 操作。萃取是把目标化合物从化合物混合物中

segments.text: compounds, whereas in a wash, you are pulling
segments.zh: 提取出来，而洗涤则是把

segments.text: unwanted impurities away from the desired product.
segments.zh: 不需要的杂质从目标产物中除去。

segments.text: In other words, you always keep the extracts
segments.zh: 换句话说，萃取液总是要保留，

segments.text: and trash the washes. This might sound confusing,
segments.zh: 洗涤液则要倒掉。这听起来可能有点绕，

segments.text: but it will hopefully become clear as we continue.
segments.zh: 但随着讲解的推进，希望你会弄明白。

segments.text: The first step in an extraction and washing sequence,
segments.zh: 萃取和洗涤流程的第一步，

segments.text: once you have decided on the appropriate solvents, of course,
segments.zh: 当然是在你选定了合适的溶剂之后，

segments.text: is filling the sep funnel. It is a good idea to use an iron ring
segments.zh: 就是往分液漏斗里加液。最好用一个铁圈

segments.text: and a nice cushy cork ring to safely support the sep funnel.
segments.zh: 加一个软软的软木圈来安全地支撑分液漏斗。

segments.text: Before you add any solvent, close the stopcock
segments.zh: 在加入任何溶剂之前，先关闭活塞，

segments.text: and place a clean dry flask under the sep funnel.
segments.zh: 并在分液漏斗下面放一个洁净干燥的烧瓶。

segments.text: This will prevent you from dumping precious material all over the dirty
segments.zh: 这样可以防止你把宝贵的物料洒得满

segments.text: bench. The flask will save you if the funnel
segments.zh: 实验台都是。如果漏斗

segments.text: leaks or the stopcock somehow opened itself.
segments.zh: 漏液，或者活塞不知怎么自己打开了，这个烧瓶就能救你。

segments.text: When the stopcock is safely closed and the flask is in place,
segments.zh: 确认活塞已关好、烧瓶也放好之后，

segments.text: pour your two solvents into the sep funnel.
segments.zh: 把两种溶剂倒入分液漏斗。

segments.text: Use a sep funnel large enough that you don't fill it more than three quarters
segments.zh: 分液漏斗要选足够大的，使液体不超过其容积的四分之三。

segments.text: full. If it is too full, you won't be able to
segments.zh: 如果装得太满，你就无法

segments.text: efficiently mix the solvents. This brings us to the next step,
segments.zh: 有效地混合溶剂。这就引出了下一步：

segments.text: mixing and venting. It is important to mix the two solvents very well.
segments.zh: 混合与放气。两种溶剂一定要充分混合。

segments.text: This increases the contact surface area and allows the distribution of solutes to
segments.zh: 这能增大接触面积，使溶质的分配

segments.text: occur very rapidly. But use caution,
segments.zh: 非常迅速地进行。但要小心，

segments.text: mixing will frequently cause pressure to build up inside of the sep funnel.
segments.zh: 混合常常会使分液漏斗内部压力升高。

segments.text: Pressure buildup is especially common when you are using particularly
segments.zh: 当你使用特别易挥发的溶剂时，压力升高尤其常见，

segments.text: volatile solvents like diethyl ether
segments.zh: 比如乙醚，

segments.text: or compounds that can generate gas like sodium bicarbonate.
segments.zh: 或者使用能产生气体的化合物，比如碳酸氢钠。

segments.text: Under acidic conditions, sodium bicarbonate will release
segments.zh: 在酸性条件下，碳酸氢钠会放出

segments.text: gaseous carbon dioxide. Before any vigorous mixing,
segments.zh: 二氧化碳气体。在剧烈混合之前，

segments.text: it is a good idea to gently swirl and invert the sep funnel.
segments.zh: 最好先轻轻旋摇并倒转分液漏斗。

segments.text: Then invert the sep funnel, holding the stopper tightly.
segments.zh: 然后倒转分液漏斗，紧紧按住塞子。

segments.text: Allow the liquid to drain away from the stopcock
segments.zh: 让液体流离活塞一端，

segments.text: and point the tip of the sep funnel away from yourself
segments.zh: 并把分液漏斗的尖端朝向远离自己

segments.text: and other people. Slowly open the stopcock to allow venting.
segments.zh: 和他人的方向。慢慢打开活塞放气。

segments.text: Now you're ready to really mix it up. Hold the sep funnel firmly
segments.zh: 现在你可以真正开始混合了。牢牢握住分液漏斗，

segments.text: and shake it vigorously for several seconds.
segments.zh: 剧烈振摇几秒钟。

segments.text: Once again, invert the funnel and vent it carefully.
segments.zh: 再次倒转漏斗，小心地放气。

segments.text: Repeat the shaking and venting until you no longer hear gas escape
segments.zh: 重复振摇和放气，直到打开活塞时

segments.text: when you open the stopcock. Then set your funnel down
segments.zh: 不再听到有气体逸出。然后把漏斗放回去，

segments.text: and let the layers settle. Ideally, two layers with a nice clean
segments.zh: 让液体分层。理想情况下，应该很快形成两层，

segments.text: interface should form very quickly. Unfortunately, things don't always go
segments.zh: 界面清晰。不幸的是，事情并不总是

segments.text: so smoothly. A thick cloudy layer called an emulsion
segments.zh: 那么顺利。有时两个溶剂层之间

segments.text: can sometimes form between the two solvent layers.
segments.zh: 会形成一层浓厚浑浊的层，叫做乳化层。

segments.text: An emulsion is a colloidal mixture of the two solvents
segments.zh: 乳化层是两种溶剂的胶体混合物，

segments.text: and is frequently caused by the presence of fine particles in the solution.
segments.zh: 常常是由溶液中存在的细小颗粒引起的。

segments.text: Getting rid of an emulsion can take some time, so if you know that you are
segments.zh: 消除乳化可能要花一些时间，所以如果你知道

segments.text: likely to generate one, your best bet is to take pains to
segments.zh: 自己很可能会产生乳化，最好的办法就是

segments.text: prevent it ahead of time. For example, gently swirling and
segments.zh: 提前下功夫预防。例如，轻轻旋摇和

segments.text: inverting your sep funnel will rarely cause an emulsion to form.
segments.zh: 倒转分液漏斗，很少会导致乳化。

segments.text: You will have to spend more time mixing because swirling is not as efficient as
segments.zh: 你得花更多时间来混合，因为旋摇不如

segments.text: shaking, but it may be worth it. Don't worry,
segments.zh: 振摇有效，但这也许是值得的。别担心，

segments.text: if you unwittingly generated a monster emulsion,
segments.zh: 如果你不小心弄出了一个超级大的乳化层，

segments.text: you still have a few options. First, you can just sit and wait. It might
segments.zh: 你还有几种办法。首先，你可以干坐着等。它可能

segments.text: clear itself up, even if it takes a few hours. If you
segments.zh: 会自己澄清，哪怕要花上几个小时。如果你

segments.text: don't have all day to finish your extraction,
segments.zh: 没有一整天的时间来完成萃取，

segments.text: try swirling the mixture gently and stirring the emulsion with a glass rod.
segments.zh: 可以试着轻轻旋摇混合物，并用玻璃棒搅动乳化层。

segments.text: If this doesn't work, add several milliliters of saturated sodium chloride
segments.zh: 如果还不行，就往漏斗里加几毫升饱和氯化钠

segments.text: solution to the funnel and swirl to mix. The sodium chloride
segments.zh: 溶液，旋摇混合。氯化钠

segments.text: increases the ionic strength of the aqueous layer
segments.zh: 能提高水层的离子强度，

segments.text: and decreases the solubility of the organic solvent
segments.zh: 并降低有机溶剂在水中的

segments.text: in the water. As a last resort, you may need to use vacuum filtration
segments.zh: 溶解度。作为最后手段，你可能需要用减压过滤，

segments.text: to filter your entire mixture through a pad of sea light.
segments.zh: 把整个混合物通过一层硅藻土（Celite）垫过滤。

segments.text: When you are carrying out an extraction and washing sequence,
segments.zh: 在进行萃取和洗涤流程时，

segments.text: it is very important that you keep track of which layer is which
segments.zh: 非常重要的一点是要清楚哪一层是哪一层，

segments.text: and what compounds are dissolved in each layer.
segments.zh: 以及每一层中溶解了哪些化合物。

segments.text: This means that you constantly need to be asking yourself,
segments.zh: 这意味着你需要不断地问自己：

segments.text: which layer is on the top? Which layer is on the bottom?
segments.zh: 哪一层在上面？哪一层在下面？

segments.text: One way to keep track of this is to know something about the densities
segments.zh: 弄清这一点的一个办法，是了解

segments.text: of the solvents you are using. In every case,
segments.zh: 所用溶剂的密度。在任何情况下，

segments.text: the solvent with the lowest density will be on top,
segments.zh: 密度最小的溶剂都在上层，

segments.text: and the solvent with the highest density will be on the bottom.
segments.zh: 密度最大的溶剂都在下层。

segments.text: This is helpful because you can generally assume
segments.zh: 这很有帮助，因为通常可以认为

segments.text: that dilute aqueous solutions have a density around one gram per milliliter,
segments.zh: 稀的水溶液密度约为每毫升 1 克，

segments.text: similar to water. The organic solvent will be in the top layer
segments.zh: 与水相近。如果有机溶剂的密度

segments.text: if it has a density less than one gram per milliliter,
segments.zh: 小于每毫升 1 克，它就在上层，

segments.text: such as hexane, diethyl ether, or ethyl acetate.
segments.zh: 比如己烷、乙醚或乙酸乙酯。

segments.text: The organic solvent will be the bottom layer if it has a density greater than
segments.zh: 如果有机溶剂的密度大于

segments.text: one gram per milliliter, such as methylene chloride or
segments.zh: 每毫升 1 克，它就在下层，比如二氯甲烷或

segments.text: chloroform. But be careful. High concentrations of
segments.zh: 氯仿。但要小心，高浓度的

segments.text: solutes can sometimes drastically affect the density of a solvent.
segments.zh: 溶质有时会大幅改变溶剂的密度。

segments.text: If you're having trouble figuring out which layer is which,
segments.zh: 如果你难以判断哪一层是哪一层，

segments.text: you may need to perform a quick solubility test.
segments.zh: 可能需要做一个快速的溶解性测试。

segments.text: Take a couple of drops of the layer in question
segments.zh: 取几滴待判断的那一层液体，

segments.text: and add them to a small amount of water in a test tube.
segments.zh: 加到试管中的少量水里。

segments.text: If the drops dissolve without turning the water cloudy,
segments.zh: 如果液滴溶解了，水也没有变浑浊，

segments.text: then the drops were from the aqueous layer. If the solution turns cloudy,
segments.zh: 那么这些液滴就来自水层。如果溶液变浑浊，

segments.text: or the drops form an insoluble layer on the bottom,
segments.zh: 或者液滴在底部形成不溶层，

segments.text: or an insoluble layer on the top, then the drops are from the organic layer.
segments.zh: 或在顶部形成不溶层，那么液滴就来自有机层。

segments.text: But even if you think you know which layer is which,
segments.zh: 但即使你认为自己知道哪一层是哪一层，

segments.text: do not discard any of the layers until you are absolutely sure
segments.zh: 在你绝对确定已经分离出全部物料之前，

segments.text: that you have isolated all of the material. Once you have a good idea of
segments.zh: 也不要丢弃任何一层。一旦你大致清楚了

segments.text: where your material is, it's time to separate the layers.
segments.zh: 物料在哪里，就可以开始分层了。

segments.text: Before you do anything, place a clean dry labeled beaker
segments.zh: 在做任何操作之前，先在分液漏斗下面放一个洁净、干燥、贴好标签的烧杯，

segments.text: under the step funnel and remove the stopper.
segments.zh: 并取下塞子。

segments.text: If you don't do this, you'll have some trouble getting any liquid to drain.
segments.zh: 如果不这样做，你会发现液体很难流下来。

segments.text: With the stopper off, open the stopcock and allow the bottom layer to drain
segments.zh: 取下塞子后，打开活塞，让下层液体流入

segments.text: into the beaker. Take it slow when you get near the interface
segments.zh: 烧杯。快到界面时要放慢，

segments.text: so that you can close the valve precisely in between the two layers.
segments.zh: 这样才能恰好在两层之间关闭活塞。

segments.text: Once you have drained the bottom layer, you have a few options.
segments.zh: 放出下层后，你有几种选择。

segments.text: If you still need to perform a wash or an extraction with the top layer,
segments.zh: 如果还需要用上层进行洗涤或萃取，

segments.text: then leave it in the funnel. Pour in the second solvent
segments.zh: 就把它留在漏斗里。倒入第二种溶剂，

segments.text: and proceed to mix and vent. If you are done with the top layer,
segments.zh: 继续混合和放气。如果上层已经处理完了，

segments.text: then pick up the funnel and pour it into a second
segments.zh: 就拿起漏斗，把上层倒入第二个

segments.text: clean dry labeled beaker. Here is a little bit of step funnel etiquette to
segments.zh: 洁净、干燥、贴好标签的烧杯。这里有一点分液漏斗的规矩需要

segments.text: follow. When you are separating the layers,
segments.zh: 遵守。分层时，

segments.text: always drain the bottom layer through the stopcock
segments.zh: 下层总是从活塞放出，

segments.text: and pour the top layer through the top. This will minimize
segments.zh: 上层总是从上口倒出。这样可以尽量减少

segments.text: recontamination of your material. Before we move on to proper post
segments.zh: 物料的再次污染。在讲萃取后的正确操作之前，

segments.text: extraction procedures, let's walk through a sample reaction
segments.zh: 我们先来过一遍一个示例反应的

segments.text: workup similar to one you might use in the
segments.zh: 后处理，类似于你在

segments.text: laboratory. Let's say that you performed an
segments.zh: 实验室里可能会用到的。假设你进行了一个

segments.text: acylation reaction to generate phenylacetate. At the end of the reaction,
segments.zh: 酰化反应来制备乙酸苯酯。反应结束时，

segments.text: you were left with a solution containing a lot more than the material you were
segments.zh: 你得到的溶液里含有的东西远不止你想要的

segments.text: looking for. So what do you do? First, you know
segments.zh: 那种物质。那么该怎么办？首先，你知道

segments.text: that phenylacetate is soluble in diethyl ether and that diethyl ether
segments.zh: 乙酸苯酯可溶于乙醚，而乙醚

segments.text: is insoluble in water. Therefore, in your workup, you will use
segments.zh: 不溶于水。因此，在后处理中，你将用

segments.text: diethyl ether as the organic layer and wash it with different aqueous
segments.zh: 乙醚作为有机层，并用不同的水溶液

segments.text: solutions to remove the impurities. Now it is time to plan out the washes.
segments.zh: 洗涤它以除去杂质。现在该规划洗涤步骤了。

segments.text: It is important that you use what you know about the impurities
segments.zh: 重要的是，要利用你对杂质的了解

segments.text: to decide on appropriate aqueous washes for your mixture.
segments.zh: 来为混合物选择合适的水相洗涤液。

segments.text: Keep in mind that the washes should only be 10 to 50 percent
segments.zh: 记住，洗涤液的用量应只占

segments.text: of the volume of the solution that you are washing.
segments.zh: 被洗涤溶液体积的 10% 到 50%。

segments.text: And make sure to repeat each wash two or three times
segments.zh: 并且每种洗涤要重复两到三次，

segments.text: to wash away as much of the impurities as possible.
segments.zh: 尽可能多地洗去杂质。

segments.text: Your crude mixture contains acetic acid, a fairly strong acid, and two weak bases
segments.zh: 你的粗混合物中含有乙酸（一种相当强的酸）和两种弱碱：

segments.text: triethylamine and demap. To get rid of the acetic acid,
segments.zh: 三乙胺和 DMAP。要除去乙酸，

segments.text: you need to wash the solution with a mild base that will deprotonate the acid
segments.zh: 你需要用一种温和的碱洗涤溶液，使酸去质子化，

segments.text: and pull the charged acetate ion into the aqueous layer.
segments.zh: 把带电的乙酸根离子拉入水层。

segments.text: Saturated sodium bicarbonate works very well for this purpose.

segments.text: So far, this looks like a pretty effective reaction workup,
segments.zh: 到目前为止，这看起来是一个相当有效的反应后处理，

segments.text: but there is one more thing to keep in mind.
segments.zh: 但还有一件事需要记住。

segments.text: Water is slightly soluble in ether, not to a large extent,
segments.zh: 水在乙醚中有少量溶解，量不大，

segments.text: but there is some water hanging around in the organic layer.
segments.zh: 但有机层里还是残留着一些水。

segments.text: One way to pull some of the water out is to wash it with saturated sodium
segments.zh: 除去部分水的一个办法是用饱和氯化钠

segments.text: chloride, otherwise known as brine. The high ionic

segments.zh: 水。大功告成！既然你已经用分液漏斗

segments.text: can with your sep funnel, it's time to dry your organic layer even
segments.zh: 做完了能做的一切，现在该用干燥剂

segments.text: more with a drying agent. Magnesium sulfate is one popular drying agent
segments.zh: 把有机层进一步干燥了。硫酸镁是一种常用的干燥剂，

segments.text: because it is quick and effective. It is also a very fine powder,
segments.zh: 因为它快速有效。它也是一种很细的粉末，

segments.text: so take care that you don't leave any of your desired material
segments.zh: 所以丢弃时要注意，别让任何目标产物

segments.text: absorbed onto the surface when you discard it.
segments.zh: 吸附在它的表面上被一起丢掉。

segments.text: Keep in mind that magnesium sulfate is also slightly acidic,
segments.zh: 记住，硫酸镁也略带酸性，

segments.text: so it may not be suitable for use with compounds that are sensitive to acid.
segments.zh: 所以可能不适用于对酸敏感的化合物。

segments.text: To dry the organic layer with magnesium sulfate,
segments.zh: 用硫酸镁干燥有机层时，

segments.text: add a small amount of the powder and swirl.
segments.zh: 先加入少量粉末并旋摇。

segments.text: Incrementally add more drying agent and swirl
segments.zh: 逐步补加干燥剂并旋摇，

segments.text: until you get the snow globe effect. There should be free,
segments.zh: 直到出现“雪花球”效果。即使静置几分钟后，

segments.text: unclumped powder in the flask, even after letting it sit for a few minutes.
segments.zh: 烧瓶中也应有自由流动、未结块的粉末。

segments.text: Sodium sulfate is another common drying agent.
segments.zh: 硫酸钠是另一种常用的干燥剂。

segments.text: Although it is slower than magnesium sulfate, it is effectively neutral
segments.zh: 虽然它比硫酸镁慢，但它基本上是中性的，

segments.text: and in its granular form will absorb less of your desired material
segments.zh: 而且颗粒状的硫酸钠在表面吸附的目标产物

segments.text: onto its surface. Drying the organic layer with sodium sulfate
segments.zh: 更少。用硫酸钠干燥有机层

segments.text: is similar to using magnesium sulfate, except you may need to look a bit
segments.zh: 与使用硫酸镁类似，只是你可能需要看得

segments.text: closer to see whether there is free, unclumped drying agent in the flask.
segments.zh: 更仔细一些，才能判断烧瓶中是否有自由流动、未结块的干燥剂。

segments.text: It is also a good idea to let the solution dry for five or ten minutes
segments.zh: 另外，最好让溶液干燥五到十分钟，

segments.text: before removing the drying agent. To remove the drying agent,
segments.zh: 再除去干燥剂。要除去干燥剂，

segments.text: perform a gravity filtration with fluted filter paper.
segments.zh: 用折叠滤纸进行常压过滤。

segments.text: Once you have filtered the entire solution,
segments.zh: 整个溶液过滤完之后，

segments.text: be sure to rinse the drying agent very well
segments.zh: 一定要充分淋洗干燥剂，

segments.text: so that you don't leave any product stuck to the surface.
segments.zh: 以免有产物粘在其表面上。

segments.text: It is a good idea to rinse the drying agent three times
segments.zh: 最好用洁净干燥的溶剂淋洗干燥剂三次，

segments.text: with clean dry solvent, adding each of these rinses to the flask.
segments.zh: 并把每次的淋洗液都加入烧瓶。
